title: Turkey Kheema
equipment: Dutch oven or heavy bottomed pan with lid
ingredients: 2 Tbsp neutral oil (vegetable or canola), divided
1 cup green peas, thawed if frozen
instructions: Heat 1 Tbsp of oil in a Dutch oven or a large heavy bottomed pan.
Add the turkey and brown until cooked through.
Remove the turkey with the slotted spoon and set aside.
Add the remainin oil and when it shimmers, add the bay leaves, mustard seeds and cinnamon stick.
When the mustard seeds begin to crackle, add the onion. Cook until the onions are translucent
Add the green chili, garlic, and salt and mix until well incorporated.
Add the tomato puree and cook while stirring frequently until the aroma of the tomatoes is all but gone.
Add the remaining spices and still well.
Add the peas and mushrooms, allowing them to cook until they are soft.
Add the browned turkey and let the mixture simmer for about 5 minutes to allow the meat to absorb the flavors.
Turn off the heat, add the lemon juice, mix well, and serve with bread or rice.
